title: Greenland mass change between April 2019 and April 2020
provider: NASA Office of STEM Engagement, original JPL data
underlying_dataset: Wiese, Yuan, Boening, Landerer and Watkins (2022), JPL GRACE and GRACE-FO Mascon Ocean, Ice, and Hydrology Equivalent Water Height RL06.1M CRI Filtered Version 3.0
input_status: Processed monthly regional mass anomalies, not raw range measurements.
selection: Two existing monthly records. Decimal years are rounded to two places and are not exact days.
uncertainty: Source column is 1-sigma, measurement plus leakage. No covariance supplied for selected months. No uncertainty interval for their difference calculated.
